aboutContact: If you have some ideas please share on Git or
aboutFeatureEditor: Very nice CodeMirror editor which comes with many perks like code marking, search, line numbers etc
aboutFeatureEncryption: Encrypt some more fragile notes with passwords (just dont forget it - passwords are not stored anywhere so no way to remind it)
aboutFeatureExport: Export & Import of local storage items
aboutFeatureServer: If you host it on some local server it provides quick access to files from different folders
aboutFeatureSlider: Slider between items and note body
aboutFeatureTabs: Tabs that can be reordered, and that are remembered
aboutIntro: PrivThing is a tool to manage notes. Provides some nice features listed below to better organize my work.
aboutOpenSource: It is Open Source. Check it on GitHub
aboutTodo: I have always some list of things that I want to add here. I usually come up with them when I use this tool and something is missing. On GitHub there is a todo file committed with such points. I am always open to suggestions and happy when some feature comes to mind that will speed things up.
clearAllSettingsConfirm: This will clear all settings. Do you want to continue?
confirmDelete: Do you want to delete this item {{item}}?
deletedNotesInfo: Notes you deleted from the browser are kept here for 30 days, then removed for good. This is only about notes kept in the browser - files from your folders are never deleted by PrivThing.
emptyTrashConfirm: This removes every deleted note for good. There is no way back. Continue?
encryptAndSaveToLocation: Encrypt with password and save to selected location
draftFoundInfo: PrivThing kept what you were typing here on {{when}}, and it was never saved. Restore it into the editor, or discard it and keep the version that is stored.
exportSecretInfo: A password protects the backup file itself, so the notes inside it cannot be read by anyone who gets hold of it. There is no way to recover a forgotten password.
errorBoundaryInfo: The app stopped unexpectedly. Reloading keeps everything that was already saved, but unsaved changes in the editor are lost.
excludeFromAll: Directories files from which would not be listed in All
fileChangedOnDisk: This file changed on disk after you opened it - something else wrote to it. Overwrite replaces those changes with your version. Reload from disk throws away what you typed here and shows the file as it is now. Cancel keeps your text in the editor so you can copy it out first.
hintCtrlS: Hint: Use Ctrl + S hot heys to quicky save document changes
hintDisable: Hint: You can disable hints in settings
hintExportImport: Hint: Notes saved in browser can be exported / imported in settings
hintHide: Hint: You can hide text content (for password for example) by wrapping it 'hide[[your text]] or just marking text and in right click menu choosing 'Hide' option
hintPassword: Hint: You can encrypt note with password - use password option when Saving as ..
hintRowClick: Hint: Click row number to copy it to clipboard
hintQuickOpen: Hint: Press Ctrl + P (or Ctrl + K) to jump straight to a note by typing part of its name
hintRightClickList: Hint: Click with right button on list to open in new notepad
hintThemes: Hint: You can change color theme of note spaces. There are ready templates in settings or you can make your own custom theme
oldNotesBackupInfo: This is only about notes kept in the browser - not about files from your folders. Those notes now live in the browser database. A copy left by the previous version is still stored here and takes about {{size}} kB.
removeOldNotesBackupConfirm: This removes only the leftover copy of your browser notes made by the previous version. Your notes and your files are not touched. Continue?
privThingIntroduction: PrivThings's data is saved to your browser's local storage (unless you save specifically to local file). Therefore it might be deleted when you delete your browsing history/cache or run disk cleaning application. You can use export / import options to backup / restore your data. Avoid using PrivThing with Incognito / Private window - your data will not be saved in those modes. Have a nice day.
providePasswordToOpenDecryptedFile: Provide password to open decrypted file
quickOpenHint: Enter opens it here, Shift + Enter in a new note space, Esc closes
rollbackItemChanges: Rollback any changes to this item
startTypingToFilterFiles: Filter by title and content(mark checkbox ->)
storageNotConfigured: Files storage folder and service not configured. You can only work with manual pick and save and localStorage files. To remove this message disable file server in settings.
question: Question
unsavedChanges: There are unsaved changes. Do you want to continue?
unveilHiddenText: Show for a moment hidden text
